title: Automated mitochondrial oxygen consumption (mitoVO2) analysis via a bi-directional long short-term memory neural network.
summary: Bi-directional LSTM classifies start/measurement points in mitoPO2 sequences, then modified Michaelis–Menten fit calculates mitoVO2. Dataset A (82 subjects) trains; independent Dataset B (43 subjects) is compared with three-rater consensus; 91% starts within ±5 samples and mean bias −0.057 mmHg s−1.
